name: Finland
intro: A community for API practitioners across Finland, connecting platform, product, architecture and governance peers.
partners: Osaango — community and APIOps Cycles support

name: Germany
intro: APIOps Germany connects API practitioners through meetups in Cologne and Nuremberg, sharing practical experience with APIs, production AI, product data, and governance.
partners: Axway — Cologne food and drinks sponsor

name: North Africa
intro: A regional Meetup group connecting API and platform practitioners across North Africa.

name: Poland
intro: API Meetup Polska with APIOps starts in Poznań on November 26, 2026, with Polish-language talks on API and AI governance and resilient hybrid platforms. The group plans to meet every two to three months in different Polish cities.

name: Spain
intro: Help bring API practitioners and platform teams together in Spain. Local organizers and hosts are welcome to help shape the first activities in Barcelona.

name: United States
intro: Distributed Meetup groups for US-based practitioners working on APIs, platforms and governance.
